issues.title: explicit tail calls: hang in const eval of recursive call
issues.body:
<!--
Thank you for filing a bug report! 🐛 Please provide a short summary of the bug,
along with any information you feel relevant to replicating the bug.
-->

I tried this code:

```rust
#![expect(incomplete_features)]
#![feature(explicit_tail_calls)]

pub const fn f() {
    become g();
}

const fn g() {
    become g();
}

const _: () = f();

fn main() {}
```

It seems there is no output here until I ctrl+c this.
`perf top` shows some activity in `_RNvMs_NtNtCs69nEItziXW1_16rustc_const_eval9interpret4callINtNtB6_12eval_context8InterpCxNtNtNtB8_10const_eval7machine18CompileTimeMachineE16init_stac`
